summary: The owner's worldview argument for F7 (#1007), built as a partition by the shared question Q-F7 so that exhaustiveness follows from excluded middle (POTENCY-ANALYSIS-PARTITION), not from a hand-picked list. The ¬F7 family splits into three cells: (a) potency with act in the same respect (Scotus' virtual act, Hegel's moving body), (b) potency without capacity, (c) unexercised capacity without potency. All three survive the approved floor (POTENCY-ANALYSIS-CELLS-SURVIVE-FLOOR): each has an interpretation with something moved (F4); F1 holds everywhere; F3 and F6 use other vocabulary. F7 is equivalent to the three cell-excluding constraints (f7IffCellConstraints), so the argument goes through only with floor items that jointly entail F7. Result: open alternative, no premise closes, cost 0. Owner continuation 2026-11-06: the later definition decision adopts the capacity-without-act sense rather than refuting these generic cells. ADOPTED-POTENCY-NONOVERLAP concerns the adopted function only. The original generic cells and survivor certificates remain valid under DEF-INDEPENDENT-POTENCY; a change of interpretation is not a counted refutation.
